root_idea.summary: The root centers on the notion of leaning or inclining.
root_idea.development: This basic notion develops into deviation from the right course or justice, deliberate inclination toward something, and physical or postural leaning in specialized Classical usages.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested noun meaning deviation from justice or right judgment.
Distinct Quran-attested active participle in the construction of inclining toward sin.

senses.definition: A manifest deviation from justice or right judgment, especially an inequitable testamentary disposition.
senses.usage_conditions: In Qur'an 2:182, it describes wrongful bias or deviation by a testator in a bequest.

senses.definition: Inclining toward sin; intending or purposing to commit it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Qur'anic construction مُتَجَانِفٍ لِإِثْمٍ, the participle denotes purposeful inclination toward sinful disobedience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclination or deviation from the right course in speech or affairs; wrongful, unjust, injurious, or tyrannical conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Classical usage, not restricted to judges or testamentary matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression on one side of the breast or chest, with the other side remaining even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description of asymmetry of the chest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persistent withdrawal from, or estrangement from, one's family.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the conventional expression جِنَافٍ قَبِيحٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To commit an act of wrongful inclination or deviation from the right course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV verbal usage describing the performance of such wrongdoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find or judge someone to have deviated from the right way in judgment, acting wrongfully or unjustly therein.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively with reference to another person's judgment or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To carry oneself with a proud, self-conscious swaying inclination in one's gait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inclination is a bodily movement from side to side while walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deliberately deviate from one's course or intentionally incline toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن for deliberate deviation and with إلى for intentional inclination toward an object or aim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for one who inclines or acts wrongfully against another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as applying to either a singular or a plural subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who walks with proud, self-conceited side-to-side swaying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term characterizes the person by the affected inclination of the gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclining away from right or acting wrongfully, unjustly, injuriously, or tyrannically.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person or adversary, including in judgment or testamentary contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclining or pendulous, said of a penis.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description applied to a man.
A specialized description applied to a bowl.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit supplies the Quranic testamentary usage and the broader general meaning of deviation.
Distinct physical meaning concerning asymmetry of the chest.
Distinct usage of estrangement from one's family.
Contains the Form IV wrongdoing sense, a transitive judgment usage, and a gait usage.
Supports the transitive judgment and proud swaying-gait applications.
Covers deliberate deviation, intentional inclination, and the inclination-toward-sin construction.
Lexical epithet for one who acts wrongfully against another.
Distinct adjectival designation for a person with a proud swaying gait.
Adjectival meaning of deviation or wrongful conduct.
Physical meaning concerning a bent back.
Specialized description of a large bowl.
Explicit Quran-attested interpretation of the phrase concerning inclination toward sin.

cautions: Lane's printed Quran references use historical citation notation and are not treated as modern verse locations; the examples here use the independently supplied QAC locations 2:182 and 5:3.
One Lane gait passage notes textual uncertainty in part of its wording; only the clearly supported general meaning of proud swaying in gait is represented.
